source.body:
### Bug Description

The ConvertAPI credential test says "Connection successful!" for any API token, even a wrong or empty one. Users find out only when a workflow runs and ConvertAPI answers with 401.

The test sends `GET https://v2.convertapi.com/convert/docx/to/pdf` with `ignoreHttpStatusErrors: true`. It has one `responseSuccessBody` rule, which fails the test when the body has `Code` 4013. The API no longer returns 4013. A wrong or missing token now gets HTTP 401 with this body:

```json
{"Code":4011,"Message":"Unauthorized. Invalid or missing API credentials."}
```

No rule matches this body, so the test passes. 4011 is the documented code for invalid or missing credentials: https://www.convertapi.com/docs/response-codes

I'm from [ConvertAPI](https://www.convertapi.com). I have a fix with a regression test ready and will open a PR that links this issue.

### To Reproduce

1. Go to Credentials and add a ConvertAPI credential.
2. Enter a wrong API token, for example `abc`, or leave the field empty.
3. Save the credential. The test shows "Connection successful!".

### Expected behavior

The test fails for a wrong or empty API token and passes for a valid one.

### Debug Info

I reproduced it on a clean `n8nio/n8n:2.47.3` container with SQLite and default settings. The test rule is the same on master, in `packages/nodes-base/credentials/ConvertApi.credentials.ts`.

### Operating System

Docker (n8nio/n8n:2.47.3) on macOS

### n8n Version

2.47.3

### Node.js Version

26.12.1

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted
